examples.title: The community garden team
examples.invocation:
Use $team-atlas. Create one infographic titled "The community garden team" with subtitle "18 roles across 6 working groups". Use this exact content map:
Planning | Site planner | Budget keeper | Season coordinator
Growing | Seed starter | Bed steward | Compost lead
Care | Watering lead | Tool keeper | Path steward
Community | Volunteer host | Workshop guide | Neighbour liaison
Sharing | Harvest coordinator | Recipe curator | Donation lead
Learning | Soil observer | Record keeper | Review facilitator
Palette: Forest green headline accent; lavender, peach, mint, blush, blue, violet cards. Use the skill's layout. No logo, author attribution or CTA. Keep every item legible and preserve the exact counts.
